name: Slum Entrance
desc1: The narrow path is barricaded heavily by a makeshift construction of
desc2: heavy wooden beams. Guards flank the only opening in this wall,
desc3: keeping a watchful eye on all who approach. It is well-known that the
desc4: slums have recently been overrun by gangs and thugs, and that the need
desc5: to keep these destructive elements away from the city proper is great.
